version.description: The plugin version answering the call.

transport.description: `ready` when every required config key and secret is set and the config is valid; otherwise `not_configured`.

secrets.description: Each declared secret name mapped to whether Orbit delivered a value. Never a value.

missing.description: Names of required config keys and secrets that are not set.

config_error.description: Why the config is invalid, naming the key; present only when it is.

channel.description: The decision channel name submissions use.

key_epoch.description: The configured channel key epoch tokens are minted under.

recent_drops.description: The latest dropped mails: sender, reason and the provider's verdicts.
